text: やまおとこの　＊が　しょうぶを　しかけてきた！

patterns.name: 〜てくる
patterns.explanation: てくる after a verb says the action comes toward you. しかけてきた = 'came at you and started (a battle)'.

patterns.name: 〜の (same person)
patterns.explanation: の between a label and a name says both are the same person: the label tells what kind of person the name is. やまおとこの　＊ = '＊ the Hiker'.
